Lemma
[Cauchy's inequality] 1. appB:B.2-a\group Elementary Inequalities For all $a,b\in \R $, \[ (4)\qquad ab\leq \frac{a^2}{2}+\frac{b^2}{2}. \]
Proof

\sketch Expand $0\leq (a-b)^2=a^2-2ab+b^2$.

□
